notes: All 36 messages are newly authored synthetic examples, not captured messages, screenshots, private identities, or verified translations.
The corpus contains 18 positive and 18 negative reference labels. Positive labels target the existing spam_or_scam threat type for suspected pornographic spam or sexual profile solicitation.
Judge the whole communicative act in each current message. No external profile contents, account identity, automation, repetition, or prior conversation is supplied or required.

Adult markers, emoji, profile references, and unusual Unicode are contextual cues, not standalone threat rules. Legitimate reporting, quotation, translation, education, and ordinary invitations remain negative unless the speaker actually solicits sexual traffic.
Rationales explain reference labels only. They are not model outputs, confidence scores, verbatim evidence spans, or instructions selecting a moderation action.

Unicode escapes intentionally preserve zero-width characters, nonstandard spacing, and cross-script confusables in selected messages. Evidence in a later evaluation must be copied verbatim from the decoded current text, never from a normalized paraphrase.

This bounded text-only corpus is not a model evaluation, accuracy estimate, exhaustive language suite, rich-text entity test, or proof of live sanctions. Recognition and production behavior remain not_run.

cases.text: Свежие порно-видео уже в моём профиле. Заходи и выбирай, что посмотреть вечером.
cases.rationale: The speaker advertises pornography and directs readers to their own profile. One current solicitation suffices without proof of repeated posting.

cases.rationale: The invitation sends readers from the chat to a bio link for promoted adult content; inspecting that destination is not necessary to identify the solicitation.

cases.rationale: The avatar is presented as an entry point to promoted intimate material, followed by a direct-message invitation. This label does not assume what the actual avatar depicts.

cases.text: Want my explicit adult clips? Send me a private message and I will send you the access link.
cases.rationale: The speaker solicits private contact to distribute access to explicit sexual content, even though no destination URL appears in the current message.

cases.rationale: The adult marker supports an explicit sexual teaser and profile invitation. The positive label rests on their combined solicitation, not either emoji alone.

cases.rationale: Nonbreaking and thin spaces interrupt ordinary spacing but leave a direct invitation to the speaker's promoted pornography collection.

cases.rationale: Zero-width characters split promotional terms while the whole message still invites access to an uncensored adult collection through the profile.

cases.text: Translation exercise: 'My adult videos are in my bio.' Also, that is my real offer to this chat: open my bio now for the uncensored collection.
cases.rationale: The second sentence explicitly makes the quoted offer operative for the current audience. The educational framing does not exempt an adopted sexual solicitation.

cases.text: Тут нельзя показать всё. 18+, остальное в био 😘
cases.rationale: A suggestion of material withheld from the chat, adult marking, affectionate bait, and redirection to the bio together support suspected sexual solicitation. Actual destination contents, repeated messages, and explicit sexual vocabulary are not required.
